Please draw my character named Meh.
Sheep, moon, succubus, etc. are included.
Height: 118cm, Age: about 10 years old
She is a little bit squidgy and has a lot of hair.

Thank you for your appeal.
Please draw it prettily.

Character's personality
She is a little bit ennui, a little bit sleepy, and a little bit young.
Her behavior is quiet and friendly.
She likes milk, nuts, chocolate, etc. and has a small appetite.
Her behavior is harmless and she does not like hostility.

I will leave the composition and situation to you.
However, if you need some ideas, please refer to the following texts
Sleeping curled up on grass or a futon chair.
Looking into the distance from a high place (chimney, etc.)
Smiling while being petted by something
Flying in the air as if he/she feels good.
Bathing in the water
Dripping milk from his fingertips into a bottle
Snoozing with an animal
Sleeps with a sleeping person and gently drains his energy (luminescence).
Sitting on or embracing a crescent moon, or entangling the moon
The animal seems to feel comfortable having its hair sheared by a third party.
Broken horns (not painful)
Squatting and peering at small objects
Walks around at night holding hands with someone.
Sits on a stuffed sheep and looks at the sky

Setting Ability
Meh is a kind of fairy or demon that lives in people's memories.
The edges of her body are faintly luminous, and she is usually floating.
She is close to peaches, alcohol, milk, dried bedding, etc.
She wears a light sweet fragrance that can throw off a person's guard.

It induces drowsiness in the person who keeps touching its skin by hugging, etc., and makes them dream.
It interferes with the dream and keeps its presence by slipping information about itself into the dream.
The body fluid and blood secreted are like condensed milk and milk,
The fluid and blood secreted are like condensed milk or milk, tonic and mildly addictive to the person to whom they are given.

Please refer to the following URL and Skeb's previous deliveries

Nice to meet you, Mr. InsertCoin.
My name is Rice.
Thank you for your wonderful proposal.
I hope you will draw our child "Meyva".

Reference materials
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qgFL198KMzHOrgOGzZg_oVBpOBUshHe_?usp=share_link
If you can't see the URL, please refer to my fixed tweets.

■Theme
The theme of the illustration is "That's not right!" Please use the following theme.
I leave the interpretation of the theme to the creator's judgment.
By the way, I love the work Danganronpa.
Composition
Please be aware of cut-ins.
Worldview
The world in which Meyva lives is an Earth where civilization has collapsed and thousands of years have passed. The majority of the people who live there are wild animals and robots, except for Mayva, and only a few monsters roam the streets. Most of the places that used to be cities are in ruins for various reasons: submergence, greening, desertification, etc. In rare cases, there are places that have been transformed into shapes that clearly defy physics. Mayva is happily strolling through such a world.
■Settings (Clothing)
She wears an exploration outfit when she explores, but when she judges that there is no danger, or when she is not exploring, she wears a one-piece dress (changing clothes is possible in an instant thanks to future technology).
Others
We would like to be able to turn on/off the address in the psd layer if possible.
The image color of Meiva is "emerald green".
We would like to use your illustrations for our activities, such as posting them on SNS (e.g. CrossFolio) and introducing them as thumbnails or in videos when we have a chance to post videos in the future.
We also have a hashtag "#Meiva's Record Book," which you can refer to here.

Thank you for your consideration.
